name: test-studio-monorepo
description: Monorepo container for studio-server (backend) + studio-ui (frontend). Each is independently deployable.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix studio-server && npm install --prefix studio-ui
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:ui
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules studio-server/node_modules studio-server/dist studio-ui/node_modules studio-ui/dist studio-ui/.angular

author: Arun Gounder <arun.gounder@thecontrast.in>
